bootstrap.method: paired issue-level nonparametric resample on each pairwise-common support
bootstrap.support_mapping: for support size n, map each common uint64 u to floor(u*n/2^64); same u matrix for every target and both candidate/matched B0

chronology.issue_order: year asc, integer issue asc, issue_instance asc
chronology.target_history_boundary: accepted #180 expanding history with inclusive 180-minute completion embargo

outcome_boundary: Gate A outcome-unexposed: target score/result/final-or-winning SP/payout/tax/ROI/settlement fields are forbidden; historical scores enter the accepted #180 state only under its frozen kickoff <= issue cutoff - 180 minute embargo
